import json, numpy as np
from experiment_io import HERE,load_prefix,summarize
from verify_innovation import replay_incomplete
r=replay_incomplete();p,d,_=load_prefix();all_o=np.arange(459,930);eligible=d[all_o].astype('U4')==d[all_o+20].astype('U4');o=all_o[eligible]
y=np.array([p[t+1:t+21]-p[t] for t in o]);years=d[o].astype('U4');errors=[]
for mode,ind in r['scores'].items():
 seeds=(17,) if mode=='constant_shift' else (17,29);arrays=[]
 for seed in seeds:
  with np.load(HERE/'local_only'/f'{mode}_s{seed}.npz',allow_pickle=False) as z:arrays.append(z['prediction'][eligible])
 prod=summarize(np.stack(arrays),y,years)
 errors.extend(abs(ind[k]-prod[k]) for k in ('score','ensemble'))
 errors.extend(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(ind['seeds'],prod['seeds']))
 errors.extend(abs(a['ratio']-b['ratio']) for a,b in zip(ind['cells'],prod['cells']))
 errors.extend(abs(ind['annual'][yr]-prod['annual'][yr]) for yr in ('2020','2021'))
report=dict(scope='Post-stop comparison of two scorer implementations on complete trajectories only; not a complete-run producer report',scalar_comparisons=len(errors),max_abs_error=max(errors),verified=max(errors)<1e-12)
if not report['verified']:raise ValueError('scorer disagreement')
print(json.dumps(report))
